# CenPho Wax (cenphowax.com)

> Central Phoenix Brazilian wax studio concept with full service, pricing, and guide content. cenphowax.com is available for acquisition — asking $50,000 USD, Escrow.com protected. Seller: Desert Rich (sales@desertrich.com).

cenphowax.com is a complete, indexed content property for a Central Phoenix waxing studio. The brand "CenPho Wax" combines "CenPho" (Central Phoenix) with the waxing category — an exact-match, hyphen-free .com aimed at boutique wax studios, multi-location beauty operators, and domain investors.

## Core pages

- [Homepage](https://cenphowax.com/): Studio positioning, the method, and domain availability
- [Domain for sale](https://cenphowax.com/domain-for-sale/): Price, what is included, transfer process, buyer FAQ, and inquiry form
- [Services](https://cenphowax.com/services/): Brazilian, bikini, underarm, facial, leg, and arm waxing with prices
- [Pricing](https://cenphowax.com/pricing/): Per-session price list
- [FAQ](https://cenphowax.com/faq/): Preparation, comfort, aftercare, and booking questions
- [Aftercare](https://cenphowax.com/aftercare/): First 48 hours and desert-climate routine
- [Guides](https://cenphowax.com/blog/): Long-form waxing articles
- [About](https://cenphowax.com/about/): Studio concept and service area
- [Contact](https://cenphowax.com/contact/): Booking and contact
